review_method: Full217-line static read of prior candidate, exact isolated snapshot/count delta check to final candidate, AST/compile of final module and embedded wrapper only. No execution of helper functions, extraction, verifier subprocess or actor.

checks.new_destination: Existing nonsymlink parent, nonexistent destination, outside source ROOT, created mode0700. Receipt is new, distinct from destination, and outside restored tree.
checks.source_identity: Required restoration/init/two-verifier sources must exist in supplied map. Every copied source is nonsymlink regular content checked with exact Git blob SHA1 formula; map bytes rehashed after copying. Immutable40-hex source commit recorded.
checks.zip_paths: Rejects absolute/empty/dot/dotdot path segments, backslashes, NUL and colon; rejects duplicate names/JSON keys, outside-prefix raw paths, symlink and other nonregular metadata, setuid/setgid/sticky bits, directories and encrypted entries. Exact manifest/member set and counts required.
checks.member_integrity: Each raw member byte length and SHA256 matches manifest; summed raw size/count checked. ZIP CRC is checked by zipfile.read. Archive SHA is read before/after, both metadata hashes recorded.
checks.overlap_and_preservation: Exclusive creation for new files; source/core/resources overlap accepted only for identical bytes and ordinary mode, otherwise fail. No source/old-evidence deletion or overwrite.
checks.elf_permissions: Requires exactly four named ELF members with ordinary executable bits. No executable is launched by restoration. Retains archive permission bits, with special bits rejected.
checks.whole_tree: Final patch includes root directory, all subdirectories and regular files via lstat, rejects symlinks/FIFOs/other special objects. File entries include SHA256,size,mode,mtime_ns,ctime_ns; directories include type,mode,mtime_ns,ctime_ns. Atime intentionally excluded. Created regular file count must match the snapshot file count.
checks.verifier_resolution: Runs same sys.executable with PYTHONPATH=new destination, cwd=new destination, bytecode writing off, optimization off. Wrapper checks resolved spec.origin and executed __file__ against intended restored module, calls exact --verify-only entry, timeout600s.
checks.verifier_read_only_scope: Reviewed builder branch calls load_complete only. Behavior verifier recomputes and compares existing diagnostic without its write branch. Restored tree checked after each completed subprocess; both exits must be0. No training, benchmark, actor, model deployment or production activation is invoked.
checks.failure_receipt: For exceptions inside established receipt scope, records failed status/error and preserves partial new destination; receipt flush+fsync in finally. Preflight invalid paths may fail before safe receipt creation; arbitrary SIGKILL durability is not claimed.

resolved_findings.finding: Prior snapshot covered only regular files and did not represent empty directories or reject all special objects.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final snapshot uses lstat for root/dirs/files, rejects special objects, records object type and metadata, separates file count from object count.

required_external_bindings: Coordinator supplies a Git blob map independently verified against the named immutable final source commit; the helper itself does not fetch or authenticate remote Git state.

Coordinator binds both input archive paths to the independently saved expected archive SHA256 receipts and verifies the returned archive identities. Internal manifests and checksums alone are not provenance.
This is a single-owner, same-runtime new-directory restoration of trusted local artifacts, not a concurrent adversarial filesystem isolation proof or fresh-environment dependency rebuild.
